2317-2921-7084-8345.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending Dwarven Mine.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Dwarven Mine.
When Dwarven Mine dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning Dwarven Mine from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed
When Dwarven Mine enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Dwarf creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio
Repeat.

4336-5006-5231-8170.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Kobolds of Kher Keep is starting in your graveyard.
4336-5006-5231-8170.description:
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Kobolds of Kher Keep spell. Then, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Kobolds of Kher Keep, adding {R}
Repeat.

4279-4314-6559--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4279-4314-6559--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Venerated Stormsinger, Pawn of Ulamog and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Venerated Stormsinger trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Pawn of Ulamog ability, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Venerated Stormsinger triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

1662-2645-3430-4348.easyPrerequisites: Ley Druid doesn't have summoning sickness.
1662-2645-3430-4348.description:
Activate Karoo by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{W}{W}{W} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Ley Druid by tapping it, untapping Karoo
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Ley Druid.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

304-4828-5261.easyPrerequisites:
Benefactor's Draught is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Isochron Scepter doesn't have summoning sickness.
304-4828-5261.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
304-4828-5261.description:
Animate Isochron Scepter using Tough Cookie.
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Benefactor's Draught without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Benefactor's Draught, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to draw a card
Repeat from step 2.

544-8182.notablePrerequisites:
Lands you control excluding Sanctum of Eternity can tap to produce {12} or more.
If you're casting Emrakul from the command zone, you must provide enough additional mana to pay for its commander tax if applicable.
544-8182.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {12}
Cast Emrakul by paying {10} plus commander tax if applicable.
Emrakul triggers, untapping all lands you control.
Resolve Emrakul. Then, activate Sanctum of Eternity's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, returning Emrakul from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2595-4694-5147-7306.easyPrerequisites: Combine Guildmage does not have summoning sickness.
2595-4694-5147-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
2595-4694-5147-7306.description:
Activate Combine Guildmage's first ability by paying {1}{G} and tapping it, causing each creature you control to enter with an additional +1/+1 counter this turn.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Combine Guildmage.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to its target.
Repeat from step 2.

3967-5170-6132-7918.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Sifa Grent triggers, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Sifa Grent trigger.
Resolve the Sifa Grent trigger, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

215-1526-6791.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five creatures.
215-1526-6791.description:
Activate Circle of Dreams Druid by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Circle of Dreams Druid from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Circle of Dreams Druid by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4050-6972-7725.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Selfless Police Captain.
When Selfless Police Captain dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Repeat.

2092-2757-7132.description:
Activate a basic Plains by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Super-Skrull's first ability by paying {W} due to Agatha of the Vile Cauldron, creating a 0/4 Wall creature token.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the Wall, untapping a basic Plains.
Repeat.

1116-2292-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
1116-2292-7084.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Sek'Kuar and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Sek'Kuar trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

6130-7299.description:
Cast Supreme Verdict by paying its mana cost, destroying all creatures.
Cast Biorhythm by paying its mana cost, causing each player's life total to become equal to the number of creatures they control.
Each player that controls no creatures loses the game due to having 0 life.
6130-7299.notes: You will also lose the game if you control no creatures as Biorhythm resolves, causing the game to end in a draw. You can avoid this by putting a creature onto the battlefield after step 1, or by having an indestructible creature. Similarly, any opponent who controls an indestructible creature will not have 0 life or lose the game.

uses.n: The Enigma Jewel // Locus of Enlightenment

74-2043-4742-6311.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, targeting Radiant Lotus.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying Urza's ability, targeting Radiant Lotus.
Resolve both Urza abilities, creating two token copies of Radiant Lotus that are 1/1 Soldier artifact creatures.
Activate a Radiant Lotus token by tapping it and sacrificing both Radiant Lotus tokens, targeting yourself.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying the Radiant Lotus token's ability, targeting yourself.
Resolve both Radiant Lotus abilities, adding twelve mana of any color.
Repeat.

773-1409-2097.description:
Activate Galazeth Prismari by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Galazeth Prismari enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Galazeth Prismari.
Resolve the Galazeth Prismari trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

2034-3188-4593-6291.description:
Activate Mite Overseer by paying {3}{W/P}, creating two creature tokens.
When the creature tokens enter the battlefield, Social Climber triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
2034-3188-4593-6291.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the creature tokens

2060-2946-4050-6701.easyPrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2060-2946-4050-6701.description:
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript is sacrificed, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Szarel's power on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.
2060-2946-4050-6701.notes: This combo can put infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel so long as its power is greater than the mana needed to activate the creature's ability from your graveyard.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a +1/+1 counter on it and has lifelink

3693-4613-5292.description:
Activate Voice of the Blessed by using Walking Ballista's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life due to its lifelink.
Voice of the Blessed triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

486-1651-4321-5251.description:
Activate Liquimetal Torque by tapping it, causing Emmara to become an artifact until end of turn.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Emmara and another artifact, targeting Emmara.
Emmara triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token and a Food token.
Resolve the Clock of Omens ability, untapping Emmara.
Repeat from step 2.

2281-3967-4549-5006.description:
Activate Relic of Legends' second ability twice by tapping Lurrus and Saffi, adding {G}{W}.
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Lurrus.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Lurrus.
When Lurrus dies, Saffi triggers, returning Lurrus from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, giving it indestructible until end of turn
Cast Saffi from your graveyard by paying {G}{W}.
Repeat.

1418-4813-5003-5147.notablePrerequisites: An opponent has lost life this turn.
1418-4813-5003-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Famished Foragers.
When Famished Foragers dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Famished Foragers from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Famished Foragers enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, adding six {R}.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use Famished Foragers' ability to infinitely rummage.

1558-3942-4840.notablePrerequisites: You have not cast a creature spell using Karador this turn.
1558-3942-4840.description:
Cast Myr Battlesphere from your graveyard by paying {7}.
When Myr Battlesphere enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating four 1/1 Myr creature tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it, sacrificing Myr Battlesphere and sacrificing the four Myr tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1308-2034-4709-5256.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two cards in your graveyard.
1308-2034-4709-5256.description:
Activate Varina by paying {2} and exiling two cards from your graveyard, creating two 2/2 Zombie creature tokens.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing a Zombie, causing you to mill two cards.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Zombie, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

1011-2034-2728-4153.notablePrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least two additional creatures.
An opponent controls a creature.
1011-2034-2728-4153.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Cast Fate Transfer by paying {1}{U/B}, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto another creature you control.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it, adding {C}{C}.
The creature dies, triggering Resourceful Defense and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability.
Resolve the Resourceful Defense trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Repeat from step 4.

1020-1117-3003-4659.description:
Pay {0} to cast Myr Retriever.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Myr Retriever to add {C}{C}.
Myr Retriever triggers, returning Junk Diver from your graveyard to your hand.
Pay {1} to cast Junk Diver.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Junk Diver to add {C}{C}.
Junk Diver triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3957-4268-4702.notablePrerequisites:
Famished Paladin does not have summoning sickness.
Splinter Twin attached to Famished Paladin.
3957-4268-4702.description:
Tap Famished Paladin to create a token copy of it with haste.
The token ETBs, triggering Kor Celebrant and gaining you 1 life.
All of your Famished Paladins trigger, untapping themselves.
Repeat for infinite creature tokens with haste.

1089-2353.notablePrerequisites:
Curiosity attached to Niv-Mizzet.
You have a way to draw a card.
Your library is greater than opponent life total.
1089-2353.description:
Draw a card.
Niv-Mizzet trigger, dealing 1 damage to any target opponent.
Curiosity triggers, allowing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.
